agent-roundtable 1.2.4

- Major documentation overhaul: comprehensive docs and specifications added to the repository.
- Added project governance files: CODEOWNERS, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE, SECURITY.md.
- Expanded documentation with detailed API references, integration guides, architecture, and design specs.
- English README (README_EN.md) and enhanced main README.md introduced.
- Removed outdated reference materials for clarity and modernization.

- Major project restructure: moved documentation and code to dedicated `docs/` and `src/skills/` directories.
- Added extensive documentation including API references, integration guides, design specifications, and architecture docs.
- Introduced new community and contribution files: `CODEOWNERS`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `LICENSE`, and security guidelines.
- Removed outdated reference files to streamline the project and focus on current features.
- Updated guides in `SKILL.md` for publishing, best practices, and clarified notification and execution models.
Fix display name to match project name: agent-roundtable
Add emoji and homepage to frontmatter metadata
Fix display name: Skills → Roundtable AI
Replace Chinese content with English in examples, fix duplicate tool entry, clean up mixed language
Initial Roundtable skill release for structured multi-agent discussions.
